## Checklist for App Submissions

- [ ] `slug` is lowercase alphanumeric with hyphens (`^[a-z0-9-]+$`)
- [ ] Repository is public and has official GitHub Releases with downloadable assets
- [ ] Ran `npm run validate` locally and all checks passed
- [ ] Checked that `assetRules` match the release file naming conventions
